description: This source file implements processing functions for handling various SLAP protocol calls within the LOAM server component of a service logic aggregation system. Functions include dispatching calls for acquiring, releasing, invoking, deleting, and updating objects via LPC (Lightweight Procedure Call) mechanisms, with detailed handling of input/output buffers, object representations, and error codes.
